_note: Non-secret AIO Tests sync conventions for the PROBE Lab. Secrets (AIO_API_TOKEN, and AIO_EMAIL only when auth is 'basic') come from environment variables ONLY — never store a token here. AIO_API_BASE_URL and AIO_PROJECT_KEY env vars override the values below. Verify with `npm run check:connections`.
_folderTemplate_doc: The {feature} placeholder puts each feature's cases in its own practice folder, so PROBE Lab practice cases never land among the real product test folders. Re-point this before syncing to a production case folder.

requirement._doc: Where a feature's PRD lives, so a synced case can link back to its requirement. PROBE Lab keeps PRDs under docs/PRDs/<feature>/.
